title: Every kitchen should own one!
text: Every kitchen should own one!. First, I really like Maison Huis kitchen products and own several of their devices. This garlic press is incredible and an excellent time and mess saver. In the past I would peel cloves and then chop them up into tiny pieces for my dishes. It sometimes could be painstakingly long to do, especially if the recipe called for 8+ cloves. This hand tool cuts the time by 75%+ and makes peeling and crushing/cutting garlic a breeze. Clean up is a breeze and I just pop it into the dishwasher and it comes out looking like new. This would make an excellent add on present for a bridal shower or home warming gift.

product_metadata.title: MAISON HUIS Stainless Steel Mincer, Crusher Peeler Garlic Press, Dishwasher Safe & Rust-proof
